name: ReactGoWebsiteTemplate
summary: Shell scripts that scaffold React and Vite websites and optional Go backend projects.
description: The pinned repository contains two Bash project-generation scripts rather than a runnable website. They use Vite's React TypeScript template, add React Router, Tailwind CSS, and TanStack Query, and scaffold a basic Go module when selected.
features: Clone a supplied repository and generate a React TypeScript Vite frontend
Install common frontend routing, styling, and query packages
Create a basic Go backend scaffold
suggested_queries: Which project creates a React Vite frontend?

sections.title: Project generator
sections.summary: Two Bash scripts generate a new project layout; the repository does not contain a generated portfolio or deployable app.

sections.title: React and Vite frontend scaffold
sections.summary: The scripts initialize a Vite React TypeScript app and install React Router, Tailwind CSS, and TanStack Query.

sections.title: Optional Go backend scaffold
sections.summary: The scripts create a basic Go module and main program when a backend is requested.

frontend.reason: The repository is a project generator and has no committed generated frontend.
